```yaml
name: Smoke tests against Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-mastodon:
    name: Run Mastodon interoperability smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify Docker Compose
        run: |
          docker compose version

      - name: Build and start services
        run: |
          docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml up -d

      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          # Wait for Mastodon
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/v1/instance > /dev/null; then
              echo "Mastodon ready"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for Mastodon..."
            sleep 5
          done
          # Wait for harness
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:4000/_test/health > /dev/null; then
              echo "Harness ready"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for harness..."
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Run orchestrator
        env:
          MASTODON_URL: http://localhost:3000
          HARNES_URL: http://localhost:4000
        run: deno run --allow-net --allow-env test/smoke/orchestrator.ts

      - name: Tear down services
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml down
```

            sleep 5
          done
          # Wait for harness

            if curl -s http://localhost:4000/_test/health > /dev/null; then
              echo "Harness ready"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for harness..."
            sleep 5
          done
